title: Brave and the Bold Batman and Wonder Woman #2 4 5 Lot DC 2018 Liam Sharp
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Brave and the Bold: Batman and Wonder Woman (DC Comics, 2018 6-issue mini-series) - written and drawn by Liam Sharp, colors by Romulo Fajardo Jr. Celtic myth horror adventure. $3.99 cover price each.

You get:
- #2 - "And the Dead Shall Come for Them!"
- #4 - "Behold... the Silver Arm! Destroyer of Worlds!"
- #5 - "Bow Before Balor of the Evil Eye!"

Not included: #1, #3, #6.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
